name: Offline banner appears with no internet connection
description: With no internet connection, a clear 'You are offline' banner appears and stays visible while moving between the wallet, menu, and settings screens. When the connection comes back, the banner disappears.
details: From a fresh wallet on the Android emulator, enable REAL airplane mode (adb cmd connectivity — the radios genuinely drop, unlike the retired settingsStore.mockOffline lever) and prove the OfflineProvider's blue YOU ARE OFFLINE shell banner appears after its ~5-6.5s hysteresis, persists across the wallet home, drawer, and settings, and clears near-instantly when the network returns. Send/receive controls stay mounted throughout; the banner wait doubles as the synchronization barrier every offline scenario needs before exercising a flow (until it commits, the app still takes online code paths)
